name: Sun Country Visa Signature® Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR not stated on benefits or FAQ page. See Credit Card Terms for details.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees when you use your card.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated on page. Subject to credit approval.

base_rate.description: 1x point per $1 spent on everything else.

categories.label: Sun Country purchases (3x when you buy with your card, plus 2x when you fly)

rewards.redemption_notes: 100 points equals $1 in Sun Country purchases. Points can be redeemed for flights, vacation packages, seat selections, and bag options. You can mix and match points and dollars to pay. Points do not expire as long as your account is open and in good standing.

benefits.title: 50% Off First Bag
benefits.description: 50% off your first bag for you and your travel companion on the same itinerary when purchasing pre-flight on SunCountry.com.

benefits.title: 50% Off Best and Standard Seat Selections
benefits.description: 50% off Best and Standard seat selections for you and your travel companion on the same itinerary when purchasing pre-flight on SunCountry.com.

benefits.title: 10,000-Point Anniversary Bonus
benefits.description: Earn 10,000 bonus points when you spend $10,000 in the 12-month period following every account opening anniversary date.

benefits.title: Preferred Boarding (Zone 2)
benefits.description: Start your journey stress-free with Preferred Boarding (Zone 2) and find your seat on the aircraft early.

benefits.title: Free Premium Drink on Every Flight
benefits.description: Enjoy a complimentary free premium drink of your choice on every flight.

benefits.title: 25% Off Food and Beverages on Sun Country Flights
benefits.description: Receive 25% off food and beverages as an exclusive cardmember discount when you use your card on Sun Country flights.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Travel internationally with no foreign transaction fees when you use your card.

benefits.title: Points Don't Expire
benefits.description: Points do not expire as long as your account is open and in good standing.

benefits.title: Path to Sun Country Plus Status
benefits.description: Earn Sun Country Rewards Plus status by taking 10 qualifying Sun Country flights or spending $10,000 on your Sun Country Visa Signature card in a calendar year. Plus status benefits include: 1 additional point per dollar on Sun Country flights booked online, Complimentary Flexible Fare (change/cancel without change fees), Priority Check-in, Priority Boarding (Zone 1), and priority security line access at MSP Terminal 2.

benefits.title: Travel & Emergency Assistance Services
benefits.description: Access to Travel & Emergency Assistance Services — call anytime, from anywhere in the world. Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply. Refer to your Guide to Benefits for more information.

benefits.title: Roadside Dispatch®
benefits.description: Access to a 24/7 pay-per-use roadside assistance program. Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply. Refer to your Guide to Benefits for more information.

benefits.title: Enhanced Travel & Lifestyle Benefits
benefits.description: Perks and discounts for hotels, car rentals, shows, golf, dining, and more through Visa Signature Enhanced Travel & Lifestyle Benefits.
